text: {"features":[{"name":"Role understanding","description":"Shows how well the letter understands this team's work as building security automation and internal systems that scale secure development across Google.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only a basic understanding that the role involves security-related software, without articulating the team's particular leverage or responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Recognizes that the role involves foundational tooling or security automation, but describes the job in broad or incomplete terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly identifies the role as building systems that reduce manual security work or strengthen the software development lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains the role as scaling scarce security expertise through automation, triage systems, or internal tooling with broad organizational impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding by connecting Google-scale leverage, vulnerability handling, developer-facing secure defaults, and AI or agent-based automation."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"Reflects how convincingly the letter explains why this specific role is a deliberate next step for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads mostly as a formulaic application statement, with little personal pull toward this work beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses broad interest in security engineering or Google, but the motivation could fit many other roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a credible reason for applying, such as wanting more security impact or more foundational work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties the role to a clear career direction, formative experience, or long-standing interest in this kind of engineering."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes a vivid and highly convincing case for why this exact role is the applicant's purposeful next step now."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"Captures the extent to which the letter frames security work as helping developers build safely with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says nothing about serving other engineers or making secure development easier for them."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams or reducing toil only in passing, without a clear enablement philosophy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear desire to help developers make secure choices more easily through better tooling or process."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames security as enablement rather than policing and emphasizes removing friction for other engineers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Pairs a strong enablement philosophy with concrete examples of building tools that returned time, capacity, or clearer defaults to other teams."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"Reflects the level of formal technical education the letter presents as preparation for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents bachelor's-level education in a relevant field and no graduate study."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents bachelor's-level education plus additional formal technical study beyond the minimum, but not a completed master's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree in a relevant technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree with explicitly advanced specialization or research relevance to systems, security, or AI."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a doctorate in a relevant technical field."}]},{"name":"Production depth","description":"Shows the breadth and maturity of the applicant's professional experience testing, maintaining, launching, and owning production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows qualifying production experience but at the lower end of this sample's breadth, with shorter tenure or fewer launched services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows modest professional breadth, with some production launches and maintenance responsibility but limited overall scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid multi-year exposure across testing, maintenance, and launch of several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production ownership over several years, including repeated launches or broad service responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents extensive, mature production engineering experience with numerous live services and strong lifecycle ownership."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"Assesses how strongly the letter establishes Go as a central professional language for relevant systems work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States professional use of Go but only as one language among many, with no signal that it is central to the applicant's work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes Go a regular language at work, but gives little sense of depth or system ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary or daily language in professional work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links strong Go usage to relevant back-end or infrastructure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sustained Go ownership that directly matches this role's back-end security-automation responsibilities."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"Assesses how clearly the letter demonstrates meaningful professional use of Python for tooling, services, analysis, or automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or leaves Python ability materially unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly, with little evidence of regular or substantive use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible working use of Python for tooling, scripts, prototypes, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive professional Python use across services, automation, analysis, or internal tools."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as production-grade and central to automation, AI, or agent-based systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Shows the strength of the applicant's practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers little evidence beyond general technical competence, with no concrete algorithmic example."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims data-structure or algorithm skill in broad terms, with only minimal supporting detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives at least one solid example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical command through impactful examples such as indexes, scheduling, graph work, streaming computation, or heuristic replacement."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithmic thinking as a standout strength, backed by sophisticated examples and clear engineering leverage."}]},{"name":"AI application","description":"Measures the depth of hands-on experience the letter shows with building and shipping AI-enabled systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of building with AI systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals interest in AI or mentions it vaguely, but without concrete implementation experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on experience building AI or LLM features, but with limited detail about context or difficulty."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes clear production experience shipping AI or LLM functionality and handling practical reliability concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial, mature AI application experience tied to evaluation, trustworthiness, or operational constraints in production."}]},{"name":"Agentic design","description":"Measures how strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems that use agents to perform bounded autonomous work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of designing agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomy only loosely, without clear architecture or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some direct work on agentic tooling or multi-step autonomous pipelines."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly describes architecting agent-based systems, typically with Python agents operating under controls enforced by other services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced ownership of bounded, auditable, well-constrained agent architectures closely aligned with security automation use cases."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Assesses how strongly the letter demonstrates building automation for vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no concrete evidence of automating vulnerability handling or report triage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Talks about security automation in general terms, but not about actual vulnerability-report workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that vulnerability intake or triage was automated, with limited detail on how the system worked."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete triage features such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or major queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline that transformed a manual queue into a scalable, largely self-serve process."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"Measures the depth of direct experience the letter shows with evaluating software or systems for security weaknesses.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no direct evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only adjacent security exposure, such as general interest or offensive practice, without assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with security reviews, threat modeling, or code review, but with limited depth or scope."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes hands-on assessment work with specific methods such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, adversarial code reading, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, substantive assessment practice across services or systems and articulates a clear evaluative approach to finding security weaknesses."}]},{"name":"Security initiative","description":"Captures proactive effort outside core job duties to build security skill through competition, certification, or other deliberate practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no proactive investment in security learning outside assigned work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light extracurricular security activity, such as occasional CTF participation or a baseline credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows sustained outside engagement through recurring CTFs or a meaningful certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong outside investment through serious competition results, an advanced certification, or clearly rigorous offensive practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional outside security development through high-level competitive results, demanding certification, or a combination that signals advanced offensive skill."}]},{"name":"Self-directed engineering","description":"Measures the depth of technical initiative shown through personal projects, open-source maintenance, or upstream contributions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful example of technical work pursued outside core job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small or lightly maintained personal project with limited depth or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a modest but real pattern of self-directed work, such as a maintained utility, occasional upstream fixes, or a simple public project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial self-directed engineering through ambitious side systems, active open-source maintenance, or repeated upstream contribution."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-directed engineering depth through technically demanding long-term builds or public projects with real users, contributors, or production-like discipline."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Assesses how concretely the letter supports its claims with examples, mechanisms, and outcomes rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims of skill or interest, with little concrete supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some examples, but many important claims remain generic, list-like, or only weakly substantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports most major claims with concrete examples, though mechanisms or outcomes are sometimes thin."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds claims in specific systems, actions, or outcomes that make the case credible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Explains achievements with unusual concreteness, showing what was built, how it worked, and why it mattered."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"Measures the clarity, correctness, and professionalism of the prose itself.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, typing, or mechanical errors that noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple visible errors or rough phrases, though the overall message remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally clear and professional, but includes a few noticeable errors or awkward spots."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean, well-edited, and easy to read, with only minor imperfections if any."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally polished, precise, and free of distracting mechanical issues."}]}]}
